title: 涌现的临界：为什么有些变化回不去——临界、涌现与形式化的边界 / The Criticality of Emergence: Why Some Changes Cannot Be Undone — Criticality, Emergence, and the Limits of Formalization
description:
中文. 本著作提出“临界”的可操作定义与检验程序，用以回答“变化究竟在哪一刻换了一个东西”。

核心主张：一次质变＝系统在某个尺度上获得不可由微观无损推出的宏观序；它有三个可观测标记（序参量跃变、临界慢化、宏观更好用），三个中两个才叫质变。

结构与证据：25 章、附录 A—X、14 幅图；以二维 Ising 作校准（T_c、γ/ν 与精确解一致，β/ν 与 ν 的偏差如实报告），以雪崩、渗流与慢化实验检验三个标记；核心发现是诊断效力与可观测尺度成正比——尺度不够时，两个竞争假设的图形会一样好看。

诚实的纪律：六个最小验证单元按“能不能真做”排序，并标明哪些已做、哪些只到部分通过；失败记录单独成节；每张图都配脚本与种子。

边界：多数社会案例只能到隐喻级；单一指标不能定向；慢化报“近”，不报“何时”。

版本：2026-10-18，212 页，25 章，14 图，附录 A—X；实验脚本与失败记录随书公开，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/emergence-critical。首选预览文件：emergence-critical-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This work offers an operational definition and test procedure for criticality, answering the question of when a change becomes another thing. Core thesis: a qualitative transition is the emergence, at some scale, of macro-order that cannot be derived losslessly from the micro-level; it has three observable markers (order-parameter jump, critical slowing down, macro-level usefulness), and two out of three are required. Structure and evidence: 25 chapters, appendices A–X, 14 figures; calibrated on the 2D Ising model (T_c and γ/ν agree with the exact solution; deviations in β/ν and ν are reported), with avalanche, percolation and slowing-down experiments testing the markers. The central finding is that diagnostic power scales with the observable scale — with too small a scale, two competing hypotheses look equally good. Discipline: six minimal verification units are ordered by feasibility and marked as done, partial or open; failures have their own section; every figure ships with a script and a seed. Boundaries: most social cases reach only metaphor; a single indicator cannot orient; slowing down reports “near”, not “when”. Edition: 2026-10-18, 212 pages, 25 chapters, 14 figures, appendices A–X.
notes: 科目（中文）：复杂系统 Complex Systems、涌现与相变 Emergence and Phase Transitions、科学哲学 Philosophy of Science、系统科学 Systems Science、科学方法论 Scientific Methodology。语言：中文（含英文摘要）。结构：25 章，约 212 页。首选预览文件：emergence-critical-print.pdf（印刷版）。引用格式见 CITATION.cff。
